lyrics:
[Intro: slow electric guitar lick, organ swell]

[Verse 1: gritty soul baritone, unhurried]
Ten years dry come the fifth of June
Used to chase the bottom of a bottle like the moon
Thought the only warm there was came out of a glass
Then you sat down beside me and you didn't even ask

[Chorus: full band, voice soars, long runs]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Verse 2: baritone, organ underneath]
I still know every bar from here to Baton Rouge
I just drive on past 'em now, I got nothing to prove
There's a chip in my pocket and a ring on my hand
One says who I was, one says who I am

[Chorus: full band, voice soars, long runs]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Guitar Solo: slow, bluesy, bending notes]

[Bridge: band drops low, voice nearly a whisper]
And on the bad nights, 'cause there's still bad nights
You don't hide the keys
You just leave on the light

[Final Chorus: biggest vocal, held note on the last word]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Outro: guitar and organ fade, ice settling in a glass]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 49 BPM, 6/8, A major. Very slow and swaying, with space after every line.

VOICE: Male baritone with grit and a great deal of power held back. He sings behind the beat and bends notes into long, bluesy runs in the chorus. A whisper in the bridge. One enormous held note at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean electric guitar playing slow blues licks between lines, Hammond organ, a round electric bass, brushed-then-stick drums with a lazy backbeat, soft female backing voices in the choruses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro lick and organ. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:54 Chorus 1. 1:38 Verse 2. 2:16 Chorus 2. 2:58 Guitar solo. 3:16 Bridge, nearly silent. 3:34 Final chorus, held last note. 3:56 Outro, ice in a glass at 4:00.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Warm, live and analogue, like a 1960s Southern soul session: room sound on the drums, organ glowing, the voice dry and close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The held note on 'sober' at 3:50.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original praises her by listing drinks. A man ten years dry would not, so this one praises her with weather, a porch and a light left on, and tells the truth about bad nights.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Testimony, gratitude, honesty, peace.
